title: From behind, again
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Wednesday. Newport. The instructor sees the coat from behind in the hall and knows it. She says his name to the back of it. He turns. She says she just wanted to see if it worked. It works. Three strokes.

panels.composition: A college hallway. WOOD from behind in the coat, walking away. The INSTRUCTOR behind him.

panels.composition: Wood walking on. From behind. The instructor watching the back of the coat. Three strokes: a coat, a hall, a woman.
